content.short: Thruster is the primary native DEX on Blast, featuring standard and concentrated liquidity with native yield.
content.description: Thruster is the definitive decentralized exchange and liquidity hub built natively for the Blast Layer 2 network. The platform is specifically engineered to integrate with Blast's unique native yield mechanics, allowing liquidity providers to earn yield on ETH and stablecoins automatically. Thruster offers a versatile trading environment that features both standard AMM pools and concentrated liquidity pools to ensure maximum capital efficiency. Deeply integrated with the Blast ecosystem, Thruster serves as a primary venue for trading and bootstrapping new Web3 projects.
content.meta: Thruster provides high-speed AMM and concentrated liquidity trading with native yield on Blast. Discover Thruster and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
